findings.title: Independent authority Faulted leaves idle management preview displayed
findings.trigger: Open a profile preview with no pending foreground work. Independently fault SessionControl.health_gate() while pool remains healthy, then process host timer tick without user events.
findings.observed_from_source: Host shutdown only tests pool.is_faulted; App.poll has no independent authority-health check. Desktop Controller.tick sees Faulted, hides only its resident renderer, cancels its facts task and returns Ok. Existing workbench canvas is neither cleared nor locked/hidden until a profile entry/action/result/canvas event calls profiles_memory_gate.
findings.impact: No proof of a write/lease bypass: writer and action gates still deny real effects. However idle profile preview and management fields survive the independent Faulted state, violating the requested fail-closed UI lifecycle and stale-preview withdrawal.
findings.narrow_fix: At start of each App.poll or host tick, inspect the cloned authority gate without Backend/session mutex. On Faulted/Stopping, clear preview, revoke local UI authority and begin_shutdown (or the existing fail-closed stop path); do not treat Starting/Committing transient phases as fatal. Add a focused native lifecycle test with real control, empty pending, active canvas and direct gate.fault().

resolution.detail: App.poll now reads terminal Faulted|Stopping from independent gate before other poll operations, invokes existing begin_shutdown (clear preview, lock, generation/cancel, nonblocking worker shutdown), sets status and renders. Normal Starting/AuthorityUpdating/Healthy not treated as terminal.

findings.title: Successful public joint save leaves a clean display editor on old saved settings
findings.trigger: Open Display editor, enter Profiles, jointly save public layout plus changed DisplaySettings, return Home and reopen Display.
findings.observed_from_source: L::Public(saved=true) updates only profiles editor. TO_DISPLAY reuses any same-owner display editor regardless of saved revision or dirtiness.
findings.impact: Display shows old saved values and later save receives a CAS conflict. CAS prevents overwrite; real desktop facts still refresh correctly.
findings.narrow_fix: After successful public joint save, update the same-owner clean display editor with saved display state. Keep any dirty display draft and its captured CAS unchanged; alternatively invalidate only clean display editor so next entry loads it on worker.

resolution.detail: L::Public saved=true refreshes only exact same-owner clean display editor via saved(state.display.clone()); dirty draft and captured CAS left unchanged.

reviewed_safety_paths.result: Profile entry/actions/canvas and outcome handling use cached owned state, atomic SessionControl checks and cloned HealthGate. Backend/session-ledger mutex plus SQLite calls occur only in Work::Profile via shared pool. Native hidden preview composition on UI uses owned data and no Backend mutex.

profile_flow begins and ends with management_identity(exact lease); Backend profiles methods obtain fresh actor/generation and guarded repository. Captured expected revisions pass unchanged to joint public/subject requests; no automatic CAS retry.

App Pending generation rejects lock-era completions before profile_loaded; profile_loaded requires Profiles screen and memory gate; Preview additionally exact-checks sequence. LOCK clears canvas before generation increment/cancel. Canvas requires preview_active, matching sequence, no pending, correct screen, owner and memory gate.

Lock captures nonsecret Profiles form without changing editor page. open_profiles preserves only same-owner dirty draft; other owner is discarded before worker directory load. Global EXIT/RETURN_DRAFT checks exact current owner across all editors. Root profile lifecycle test covers half-number, other-owner refusal, busy native LOCK and old drop event but is not execution evidence here.

Every dispatched profile operation first clears existing canvas. Before native hidden preview render, Controller.release_for_preview hides resident surfaces and release_surfaces drops raster caches. App.tick settings_open includes visible workbench, preview_active and Profiles screen; controller returns before real present in that case. Temporary hidden preview renderer drops before returned image installation. No second worker pool or file-open effect is introduced.

LOCK allowed before busy guard; locks exact local control before ticket cancel. Close and WTS route through lock and clear preview. OS SHUTDOWN invokes begin_shutdown, clears preview via lock and uses existing worker shutdown path.

final_static_conclusion: No remaining blocking issue found in reviewed root integration paths after two source fixes. This does not certify author-owned editor/preview rules independently or substitute Windows/native execution.
